min_age.description: Required for age_verification: a whole number from 12 to 25. Xident rounds it up to the next of 12, 15, 18, 21 or 25 and enforces that band, so 19 is enforced as 21. An id_verification takes no age: leave it out or send 0. Any other value is refused with INVALID_MIN_AGE.

purpose.description: One of: age_verification (default) or id_verification. An id_verification always needs a document and a face match, and takes no min_age. Any other value is refused with INVALID_PURPOSE.

verification_mode.description: One of: auto (default), document (an ID document and a face match are always required), or facial (on-device only, never a document). facial cannot be combined with purpose id_verification, which always needs a document. Any other value is refused with INVALID_VERIFICATION_MODE.

callback_url.description: REQUIRED. Where the widget returns the person after the flow: HTTPS, or http://localhost in development. A missing one is refused with MISSING_CALLBACK_URL.

user_id.description: REQUIRED. Your own identifier for the person being verified. It comes back on the callback and in the result. Must not be a Xident key or token. A missing or blank one is refused with MISSING_USER_ID.

idempotency_key.description: REQUIRED. A stable key for this logical request. Retrying with the same key returns the same session instead of creating a second one.

user_id.description: Your identifier for the enrolled person

image.description: Base64-encoded image of the face to check
